title: Oil Rubbed Bronze Grab Bar, 63-Inch 3-Post Wall-Mounted Iron Pipe, ADA Compliant, Allied Brass
description: Grab bar for bathroom safety and accessibility, 63 inches long (63-inch, 63 in) with a 3-post design and third center bracket for stability in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. Wall mount / wall-mounted installation. Iron pipe construction with a highly durable powder coat finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. ADA compliant bathroom grab bar for balance and support in showers, tubs, and near toilets. Also searched as: safety bar, bathroom grab bar, ADA grab bar, support bar. Industrial pipe-style look for industrial bathroom hardware and loft bathroom fixtures; coordinates with matching pipeline pieces and pipe-style bath accessories in the Pipeline collection. Product size: 63 in L x 3 in H x 3.58 in projection. Weight capacity: 250 lb. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Pipeline.
